caption: Co-changes under SSP5–8.5, 2071–2100 relative to 1991–2020. (a) Area/valid-pair-weighted affected-tissue change in two-day bins of F1 symptom-timing shift relative to modelled GS65; negative shifts indicate earlier symptoms. Equal timing/complete-season valid-pair counts identify identical paired years. Displayed bins represent at least 0.5% of each GCM’s full-domain paired-area weight. (b–d) GCM-specific weighted changes in GS65–85 mean temperature (b), accumulated rainfall (c) and duration (d), grouped by unanimous increase, mixed/zero signs or unanimous decrease in affected-tissue damage. Membership is shared across GCMs; unavailable cells remain in source data. Window climate incorporates shifted phenology. Timing is an internal state entering the tissue endpoint, so associations establish neither independent validation nor causal mediation. GS65 is a modelled gate, not independently validated anatomical anthesis. Affected-tissue days are the normalized symptom-tissue proxy defined in Figure 6. Timing associations describe the matched symptom-event subset; geographic retention is reported in Section S3.
